clause: Flow model + named starting points + per-flow settings [STU-PRO-001,STU-PRO-002,STU-PRO-003,STU-PRO-003a]

scope.summary: Implement the flow model on StudioPrototypeFlow: multiple named starting points per page (each defining an entry path, listed in the flow sidebar and independently launchable, several flows per page); and per-flow settings letting interactive-component state and variable values either reset or persist on navigation, optionally preserving the destination's scroll offset from the origin (MT-387), and maintaining navigation history so the back action (MT-378) is well-defined (overlays layer above without pushing history unless configured). The flow sidebar + settings are an operator surface.
acceptance_criteria: named starting points per page + reset/persist + nav-history settings; author_ids + manual entry
expected_tests: argus: flow sidebar + starting points + prototype settings reachable via author_ids
live: multiple named starting points per page launchable; state reset/persist toggle; navigation history maintained for back

target_entries: Studio / Prototyping / Flows and starting points

risk_if_missed: No flow starting points or settings; prototypes have no entry paths or state model.

risks: Scaffold-only claim without runtime proof (Spec-Realism Gate).
Domain MT forking a canonical primitive instead of referencing 14.23.
SQLite creep on a studio_* write path.
minimum_controls: At least one proof command exercises executable runtime or a Handshake-managed resource boundary.
Reference canonical primitives (14.23); no shadow primitives.
